name: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex
fire_suppression_protocol: Class B AFFF Foam only. Deploy fixed monitor deluge systems. Do not use high-pressure direct water jets on volatile hydrocarbon storage tanks.
nearest_fire_station: Motikhavdi Industrial Fire Station (1.2 km)

name: IOCL Paradip Refinery Complex
fire_suppression_protocol: Medium-expansion Class B Foam, dry chemical powder for gas manifold leaks. Isolate pipeline feed valves immediately.
nearest_fire_station: Paradip Port Trust Fire Brigade (3.5 km)

name: Hazira Industrial & LNG Terminal
fire_suppression_protocol: Cryogenic hazard protocol. Use high-expansion foam blankets for LNG vapor dispersion control. High-volume water spray for boundary thermal cooling.
nearest_fire_station: Hazira Industrial Area Fire Post (0.8 km)

name: CPCL Manali Petrochemical Corridor
fire_suppression_protocol: Alcohol-resistant AFFF (AR-AFFF) foam, toxic vapor neutralizer curtains. Evacuate surrounding residential fringes downwind immediately.
nearest_fire_station: Manali Fire Station (1.5 km)

name: IOCL Panipat Petrochemical Complex
fire_suppression_protocol: Dual-agent foam and dry chemical powder for high-pressure gas fires. Remote monitor cooling on cracker distillation columns.
nearest_fire_station: Panipat Refinery Internal Emergency Center (0.5 km)

name: IOCL Mathura Refinery
fire_suppression_protocol: AFFF Class B foam deluge. Activate perimeter sulfur recovery emission containment scrubbers.
nearest_fire_station: Mathura Refinery Fire Post (1.0 km)

name: BPCL/HPCL Mahul Trombay Refineries
fire_suppression_protocol: Coastal seawater high-pressure deluge, AR-AFFF foam system. High population density alert: immediate traffic lockdown on Mahul corridor.
nearest_fire_station: Chembur/Mahul Fire Brigade (1.8 km)

name: Haldia Petrochemicals & IOCL Complex
fire_suppression_protocol: Alcohol-resistant foam, water spray curtains for vapor suppression. Alert port authorities to halt maritime traffic.
nearest_fire_station: Haldia Port Fire Station (2.0 km)

name: HPCL Visakhapatnam & Steel Corridor
fire_suppression_protocol: Dry sand and Class D powder for molten slag/metal fires. Class B foam for refinery zone. NEVER use water on molten metal.
nearest_fire_station: RINL Industrial Fire Station (1.1 km)

name: Tata Steel Jamshedpur Works
fire_suppression_protocol: Class D metal fire extinguishing agents for ladles. Inert gas purging for coke oven gas lines. Massive water deluge on structural steel only.
nearest_fire_station: Tata Steel Central Fire Brigade (0.5 km)

name: SAIL Rourkela Steel Plant (RSP)
fire_suppression_protocol: Class D dry powder for hot metal areas, nitrogen gas flooding for electrical control rooms and gas mixing stations.
nearest_fire_station: Rourkela Steel Plant Fire Services (0.9 km)

name: SAIL Bhilai Steel Plant (BSP)
fire_suppression_protocol: Class D powder for metallurgical zones, high-capacity foam pourers for coal chemical storage units.
nearest_fire_station: Bhilai Sector 1 Industrial Fire Station (1.4 km)

name: Jindal Steel & Power / NALCO Angul
fire_suppression_protocol: Class D fluxes for potline fires. High-velocity water spray systems for coal conveyors and turbine lube oil skids.
nearest_fire_station: NALCO Smelter Plant Fire Brigade (1.0 km)

name: NTPC Korba Super Thermal Power Station
fire_suppression_protocol: Deluge foam system for boiler burner fronts, water mist on coal conveyor belts, dry chemical for transformer yard.
nearest_fire_station: NTPC Korba Plant Fire Services (0.6 km)

name: Singrauli Coalfields & NTPC Super Thermal
sub_type: Open Cast Coal Mining & Thermal Power
fire_suppression_protocol: Soil blanketing and inert nitrogen/carbon-dioxide injection for coal seam fires. Continuous water tankers for dust damping.
nearest_fire_station: NCL Central Mine Fire Station (2.2 km)

name: BCCL Jharia Coalfield Mining Belt
fire_suppression_protocol: Surface sealing with fly-ash/sand slurry flushing. Trench isolation to cut off oxygen supply to active coal fires.
nearest_fire_station: Dhanbad/Jharia Mines Rescue Station (1.0 km)

name: Dahej Petroleum, Chemicals & Petrochemicals SEZ
fire_suppression_protocol: Specialized Hazmat neutralizing curtains. Caustic water spray for toxic gas scrubbing. AR-AFFF foam for solvent fires.
nearest_fire_station: Dahej PCPIR Mutual Aid Fire Station (1.2 km)

name: BPCL Kochi Refinery & FACT Complex
fire_suppression_protocol: Water spray curtains around ammonia storage spheres to absorb toxic vapor. Class B foam for refinery tanks.
nearest_fire_station: Ambalamugal Industrial Fire Post (0.7 km)

name: MRPL Mangalore Refinery & Petrochemicals
fire_suppression_protocol: High-volume foam monitor skids. Coastal environmental barrier deployment to prevent marine runoff.
nearest_fire_station: MRPL Internal Fire Operations Center (0.4 km)

name: Bharat Oman Refineries (BORL) Bina
fire_suppression_protocol: Semi-fixed foam pourers on floating roof tanks. Emergency flare blowdown system activation.
nearest_fire_station: Bina Refinery Fire Station (0.6 km)
